philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines–Filipino runner Cyril Cloyd Ongcoy lost his bronze-medal position after a jury overturned the disqualification of Uzbekistan’s Fakhriddin Khamraev at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games in Japan. Philippine delegation chef de mission Francis  Diaz said he filed a formal manifestation after the men’s 1,500-meter T12/T13 results were posted Wednesday without indicating that an appeal was pending. philippines.title: SWS: Fewer Filipinos follow Duterte trial than past impeachments
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — Fewer Filipinos closely followed the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte compared with past impeachment proceedings, the Social Weather Stations (SWS) reported. According to its survey conducted from Sept. 21 to 27, only 42 percent of adult Filipinos followed Duterte’s impeachment trial “very or somewhat” closely. The SWS said this was lower than the 47 percent recorded in January 2001, during the impeachment trial of then-President Joseph Estrada. Meanwhile, 52 percent and 54 percent of Filipinos followed the impeachment trial of then-Chief Justice Renato Corona, according to the SWS surveys conducted in March and May 2012, respectively.
